name: Splendid Venice
insider_take: This elegant palazzo perfectly captures Venice's timeless romance while delivering modern luxury just steps from San Marco Square.
whats_special: Housed in a beautifully restored 14th-century Venetian palace, Starhotels Splendid Venice combines authentic period architecture with contemporary amenities. The hotel's prime location on Mercerie, Venice's historic shopping street, puts you at the heart of the action while offering stunning views of the Grand Canal from select rooms. As part of Preferred Hotels' Platinum Program, guests enjoy exclusive perks and elevated service standards.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Grand Canal, and time your arrival during acqua alta season (October-December) to witness Venice's dramatic high tide phenomenon from the comfort of your room.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers panoramic views of Venice's iconic skyline and bell towers. Take advantage of the direct walking access to St. Mark's Basilica and Doge's Palace (just 2 minutes away), and explore the nearby Rialto Bridge and market, easily reachable via the historic Mercerie shopping route right outside your door.
pros: Prime location near St. Mark's Square and major attractions
Elegant Venetian palace architecture with authentic historic charm
Exceptional concierge service and personalized attention
Stunning canal views from select rooms and terraces
cons: Historic building with compact room sizes typical of Venice palaces
Premium pricing reflecting central Venice location
